subject.title: macOS app: dashboard fails silently with unresolved ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN} placeholder when env var not in app's environment, with no in-app recovery path

question: Which linked PR should become the canonical fix path for the macOS dashboard auth placeholder lockout?
rationale: The issue remains source-reproducible, but multiple open PRs overlap the same root cause and some address only gateway-side behavior or only the symptom.

options.title: Land strongest native fallback PR
options.body: Review and land the linked PR that updates the macOS resolver to match SecretRef env-template grammar, preserve LaunchAgent fallback, and prove the Finder/Dock launch scenario.

options.title: Choose another linked candidate
options.body: Use a different open linked PR if it provides cleaner upgrade behavior, stronger real macOS proof, or better owner-boundary coverage.

options.title: Create replacement only if candidates stall
options.body: Keep this issue open and create a narrow replacement only if the existing linked PRs cannot be brought to a landable state.

recommendation.title: Land strongest native fallback PR
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR that updates the macOS resolver to match SecretRef env-template grammar, preserve LaunchAgent fallback, and prove the Finder/Dock launch scenario.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history on the macOS gateway endpoint resolver and dashboard URL builder that need the canonical fix.
